To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This change updates browser authentication, agent onboarding, desktop lifecycle supervision, cross-platform contracts, CWS validation, and v0.9.0 release evidence. It adds reviewed Intel macOS runtime acquisition and qualification support. ### Changes **Desktop web and lifecycle** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Web configuration and agent connection**
`crates/hieronymus/src/web_config.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/daemon/rest/*`, `frontend/src/web/*`|Adds configurable browser authentication, centralized authorization, agent preparation, authority attribution, and a new agent-connection UI.| |**Server, tray, and service-aware launch**
`crates/hiero/src/daemon/mod.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/desktop/*`, `crates/hiero/src/main.rs`|Adds sidecar supervision, service-aware launch arguments, graphical-session checks, and stopped-state exit behavior.| **Windows and cross-platform contracts** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Portable launch and installation contracts**
`crates/hiero/tests/*`, `crates/hiero/src/uninstall.rs`, `crates/hiero/tests/service_cli.rs`|Expands Windows-compatible fixtures and validates service registration, uninstall behavior, private credentials, stable launchers, and platform paths.| |**Desktop CI contract execution**
`.github/workflows/desktop-candidate.yml`, `.github/workflows/pr.yml`|Runs helper, uninstall, worker, private-file, and Windows contract tests with updated workflow permissions and staging credentials.| **CWS project and authority** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**CWS parsing and project discovery**
`crates/hieronymus/src/cws_project.rs`, `crates/hieronymus/tests/cws_project.rs`, `crates/hieronymus/src/lib.rs`|Supports additional frontmatter separators and adds project, manifest, binding, direction, path, symlink, and compatibility coverage.| |**Project context and input safety**
`crates/hiero/src/project_context.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/application/mod.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/main.rs`|Rejects unsafe non-UTF-8 paths and arguments and normalizes explicit and default language values.| **Release evidence and reviewed runtime** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Reviewed runtime acquisition and packaging**
`scripts/reviewed-runtime.ts`, `scripts/release-build.ts`, `scripts/desktop-ci.ts`, `scripts/release-assets.ts`, `.github/workflows/release-rust.yml`|Validates reviewed Intel runtime provenance, archives, receipts, candidate evidence, and release publication inputs.| |**Qualification evidence validation**
`scripts/check-desktop-evidence.ts`, `scripts/check-desktop-evidence.test.ts`, `docs/desktop-qualification.md`|Adds qualified, partial, and unqualified evidence states with status-specific scale, pass, gap, reason, and digest validation.| |**Qualification and release records**
`docs/desktop-release-notes.md`, `docs/maintenance/v0.9.0/*`, `README.md`|Updates release, maintenance, installation, product-direction, and qualification documentation for v0.9.0.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~100 minutes **Change:** Feature

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
